clips.title: The story
paras: In Menethil Harbor, prominent tanner James Halloran needs fresh skins from young marsh crocolisks. Their cured hides are in demand across the sea, so steady hunting keeps his trade supplied. Bringing him the softer skins earns his trust and leads to more leatherworking chores.

Menethil Harbor links the Eastern Kingdoms to distant continents, and its busy local economy draws on the surrounding marsh. James Halloran tans and cures hides from the region's abundant reptilian predators for trade across the sea. Merchants and ships carry his leather goods to distant ports, keeping pressure on his workshop to maintain a steady supply.

Einar brings Halloran regular hauls of mature hides, but those are too firm for some luxury goods. Halloran relies on passing travelers to fill the shortage of softer leather by hunting young crocolisks in the shallow bogs just outside Menethil's palisades. The skins must stay intact for Halloran's careful curing process.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.
Met Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.
I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.
Being that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the marshes right outside of town.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, right? Do you have my skins?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Nice work you've done here, friend. The quality of these skins is superb. I'll have to get them into the curing process as soon as possible. Oh, but before I get to that, there's some other work I need done that I think you might be able to take care of.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
